name: RankAuthority
description:
Connect Claude to your RankAuthority account to manage SEO workflows across your websites. View projects, tracked keywords, SEO recommendations, blogs, RankFast campaigns, RankLink silos, AI Visibility, integrations, generation quotas, and subscription status.

Manage keywords and AI Visibility prompts, approve SEO recommendations, schedule content, start supported CMS and Google Search Console connection flows, and launch quota-guarded AI content generation.

Every request is limited to projects the signed-in user owns or can access. Read-only and write tools are clearly separated, and paid generation requires explicit confirmation before quota is consumed.

_published_faq.name: How do I add RankAuthority to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add RankAuthority to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.rankauthority.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the RankAuthority MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: RankAuthority lists 43 MCP tools, including add_aiv_prompts, add_keywords, approve_all_recommendations, approve_keyword_suggestions, approve_recommendation, delete_aiv_prompts, delete_keywords, generate_aiv_artifact, generate_blog, generate_rankfast, get_aiv_dashboard, and get_app_link.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to RankAuthority?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to RankAuthority in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
RankAuthority requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
RankAuthority is developed by RankAuthority. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
